_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. classpass.com declares no design-token CSS variables — its four custom properties are carousel-dot colours and framework internals (raw/css-vars.json). Every leaf is a measured value resolved from raw/components-computed.json at build time.

0.description: White — the html element's painted ground and the card fills.

100.description: The soft light-blue plan pill (and the plan card's tinted area).

400.description: The link blue — 'Forgot password?', and the focused field border.

500.description: The ClassPass accent — CTAs, links, the star rating.

200.description: The sign-in field and search-field hairline.

300.description: Control borders on the filter pills, panels and OAuth buttons.

400.description: Muted text — the venue card's secondary line.

500.description: Placeholder text in the search comboboxes.

800.description: The near-black button fill (walkthrough Next, CMS CTAs).

900.description: Black — body text and the footer field.

8.description: The 8% black scrim on the hero card.

10.description: The brand-tinted shadow under the plan card.

walk-slide-ink.description: The walkthrough slide's 20px medium label ink.

ui.description: TT Norms Pro ('norms') across the UI: nav, body copy, controls.

display.description: Circuit, the condensed display face of the hero and plan headings.

hero.description: The hero heading's 36px line — the rotating word paints on an inner span.

h2.source: computed fontSize of section-title default (raw/components-computed.json); stale: kept from an earlier run (the 2026-11-16 recapture did not find section-title)

page.description: The white page ground — painted by the html element (body itself is transparent).
page.source: computed backgroundColor of page-ground default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.0

card.description: The card fill: plan slides, venue rows, filter panels, search box.
card.source: computed paint.0.bg of plan-slide default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.0

dark.description: The black island: the site footer on every page.
dark.source: computed backgroundColor of footer default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.900

primary.description: Body and heading ink on the light pages.
primary.source: computed color of page-ground default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.900

muted.description: Secondary text — the venue card's muted line.
muted.source: computed textStyle.color of venue-card default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.gray.400

placeholder.description: Placeholder text inside the search comboboxes.
placeholder.source: computed placeholder.color of search-field default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.gray.500

onDark.description: Text painted on the black footer.
onDark.source: computed color of footer default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.0

onAccent.description: Text painted on the blue CTA.
onAccent.source: computed color of universal-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.paper.0

accent.description: Blue text — the filter pills' labels and the star rating.
accent.source: computed textStyle.color of filter-pill default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.500

link.source: computed color of signin-forgot default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.400

accent.source: computed backgroundColor of universal-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.500

accentHover.source: computed backgroundColor of universal-cta hover (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.600

accentPressed.source: computed backgroundColor of universal-cta pressed (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.700

accentSoft.description: The light-blue plan pill and tinted plan area.
accentSoft.source: computed paint.0.bg of plan-pill default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.100

promo.source: computed backgroundColor of m-banner default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.yellow.300

ink.description: The near-black button fill (walkthrough Next, CMS CTAs).
ink.source: computed paint.0.bg of walk-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.800

inkHover.source: computed paint.0.bg of walk-cta hover (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.ink.750

navHover.source: computed backgroundColor of nav-item hover (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.gray.100

card.description: The 8% black scrim on the hero card.
card.source: computed paint.0.bg of hero-card default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.black-alpha.8

subtle.description: The field hairline — sign-in and search inputs.
subtle.source: computed paint.0.border of signin-email default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.gray.200

control.description: The 1px border on pills, panels, OAuth buttons and the search box.
control.source: computed paint.0.border of filter-pill default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.gray.300

card.source: computed paint.0.border of venue-card default (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.black-alpha.10

focusField.description: The blue the sign-in fields' border switches to when focused.
focusField.source: computed borderTopColor of signin-email focused (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.400

focus.description: The designed focus ring on the blue controls (2px solid). Many text controls keep the browser's auto ring instead (#101010) — recorded per entry.
focus.source: computed outlineColor of universal-cta focus-visible (raw/components-computed.json); same value as core.color.blue.500

card.description: The brand-tinted drop shadow under the plan card.

heightButton.description: The full-width button height (sign-in submit, OAuth buttons, walkthrough Next).
